services.name: Sunset Dinner Cruise
services.desc: The Gondola Getaway is now offering something like never before, a Sunset Dinner Cruise! We have been doing pizza cruises now for many years for private groups but we are now offering a “community” family style that allows you to reserve a seat even as just one! Your reservation will land you a seat on the most unique dining experience in Southern California. Our large Gondola is fit with a custom table that seats 10. Your dining experience will float you through the enchanting canals of Naples with two trained Gondoliers as you dine on antipasto, pasta, pizza, salad and garlic bread.
